context: The mission defines gates G0-G8 and a lifecycle with nine states, but does not state exactly which transition each gate guards.
problem: How should gates map onto lifecycle transitions without overlap or gaps?

options_considered.option: One gate per transition, with G2/G3 and G6/G7 sharing transitions
Introduce extra lifecycle states so every gate has its own transition

decision: Map gates as: G0 DRAFT->DISCOVERY, G1 DISCOVERY->PLANNING, G2+G3 PLANNING->ACTIVE, G4 ACTIVE->VERIFICATION, G5 VERIFICATION->ACCEPTANCE, G6+G7 ACCEPTANCE->RELEASED, G8 RELEASED->OPERATING.
reason: It uses all nine specified gates and all nine specified states without adding bureaucracy or inventing states.
consequences: Gates.json and lifecycle.json encode this mapping and tests assert consistency between them.
author: implementation-agent
